strongerDirectMeasurement.method: Resolved every hex-valued colour token from figma-variable-defs.json through each theme's full brand-light var() indirection chain and compared exact values.

themeMappingFinding.visualConfirmation: Under sanoma-learning the logo tile, Create class button and 'No method added' text render the design's blue exactly. testing/home-page.png
themeMappingFinding.batchLevelImplication: The coordinator's `max` came from a different NSP file (a8-nsp-group-list). Two NSP designs in this batch need two different themes, so a per-TEAM theme mapping cannot be correct in principle - it has to be derived per FILE from its own variable defs.

stage4Discrepancies: `users` glyph (student-count badge) and `image` glyph (card media area) absent - genuinely not in the theme's icons.ts. Left out per runbook; not drawn, not stubbed.

`circle-info` glyph (No method added row) absent. The theme does register a different `info` glyph - a plausible but not identical stand-in; left out rather than substituted, flagged for a human decision.
Avatar renders initials ('LS') instead of the design's photo - the pipeline has no asset-export step, so avatarUrl is left undefined rather than 404ing.
Media placeholder grey is --sl-color-background-neutral-bold, ~1 step lighter than the design's flatter mid-grey. Token chosen over pixel-matching.
RESIDUAL: nav trailing edge sits 10px short of the design (profile pill width). 1 of 3 repair iterations used.
CORRECTED: `plus` was wrongly on this list - it IS theme-registered and is now rendered.
NOT A CODE DEFECT: the green-vs-blue colour family was entirely the wrong theme (sanoma-pro). Under the correct sanoma-learning the colours match the design exactly.
orchestratorFixes: size token trap: manifest listed --sl-size-500 as 20 (Figma Size/500=20) but the theme token is 40px. Fixed placeholder padding to --sl-size-250.
56px nav height and 48px gutters were briefed as 'no token exists'; --sl-size-700 and --sl-size-600 are exact. Fixed.

ScopedElementsMixin on the root gave it a private registry; the 3 children self-registered globally only, so they rendered as inert unknown elements (page host 120px tall, nav+cards+blocks all missing). Fixed by listing them in scopedElements.

`font:` shorthand built from --sl-text-new-typeset-fontFamily-* pins a single family with no generic fallback -> serif when the Typekit webfont is unavailable. Converted to longhands in home-page h2, top-nav links, placeholder-block.
Cards in a row did not share a height (5C shorter than 5B/5A); design rows are equal-height. Added block-size:100%.
